617:t_017:14.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Are you saying you've become the ruler of that fundamental calamity yourself?」

617:t_017:15.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Because I judged it necessary.」

617:t_017:17.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I seek still greater power! $c...! That power is you!」

617:t_018:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「They're a different type from the ones $$ガイオウ$$ had!」

617:t_018:2.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$ヴィルダーク$$! Are you planning to turn us into $$次元獣$$s, too?!」

617:t_018:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「There is no need for that.」

617:t_018:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Becoming a $$次元獣$$ certainly strengthens both human and machine. But their strength stops growing there.」

617:t_018:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「In the end, they cannot match warriors who grow without limit.」

617:t_018:7.en:
$$タケル$$
「You're saying the same thing as $$ガイオウ$$!」

617:t_018:8.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I... seek infinite strength. To attain it, I must fight the strong.」

617:t_018:9.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$悲しみの乙女$$, $$傷だらけの獅子$$, $$揺れる天秤$$, $$いがみ合う双子$$... Offer me your $$スフィア$$s.」

617:t_018:10.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「And $c! Become offerings to make me grow stronger!」

617:t_018:12.en:
$$セツコ$$
「We will not accept someone who sacrifices others for his own goals!」

617:t_018:13.en:
$$クロウ$$
「In the end, you're just like $$ガイオウ$$ at your core. We can't let someone like you go.」

617:t_018:14.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That's good! I would rather have you as enemies than comrades!」

617:t_018:16.en:
$$宗介$$
「Whatever his origins, he's still with $$サイデリアル$$ and still the $$新地球皇国$$'s emperor!」

617:t_018:17.en:
$$万丈$$
「If you've shown everything you've got, all that's left is to fight until one side wins!」

617:t_018:18.en:
$$シモン$$
「And we're the ones who'll win!」

617:t_018:19.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Come, $c! I will test the power of a $$次元将$$ and four $$スフィア$$s on you!」

617:t_018:20.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「My name is $$次元将ヴィルダーク#pilot$$! I am the strongest power, surpassing even fate!」

617:t_020:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Is that all you've got...?!」

617:t_021:1.en:
$$チコ$$
「Are you saying that's the $$スフィア$$s' power too?!」

617:t_021:2.en:
$$トライア$$
「No! That $$次元力$$ is being supplied from the Imperial Palace!」

617:t_021:3.en:
$$カヲル$$
「There's a system there that controls this planet's $$オリジン・ロー$$.」

617:t_021:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「He's using the spirit quanta... the life force... of the people abducted from all over the world!」

617:t_021:5.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「But the people whose life energy is absorbed that way...!」

617:t_021:6.en:
$n
「They develop the $$血塗られた眼$$ and become little more than empty shells...」

617:t_021:7.en:
$$勝平$$
「That's cowardly, Dimensional Emperor! Forcing the power of Earth's people to become your own!」

617:t_021:8.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Say what you like. I will make everything I can use into my strength.」

617:t_021:9.en:
$$セツコ$$
「That's why you took $$バルビエル$$ and the others' $$スフィア$$s...!」

617:t_021:10.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I don't feel like sympathizing with villains, but it's not a pleasant sight.」

617:t_021:11.en:
$$ランド$$
「But now we know how it works! If we smash that huge damn building, he can't cheat anymore!」

617:t_021:12.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「It is useless. An absolute barrier surrounds the Imperial Palace.」

617:t_021:13.en:
$n
「Is that the power that stopped me when I charged in before...?!」

617:t_021:15.en:
$$トライア$$
「I'll teach you, $$ヴィルダーク$$...! There are no absolutes in this world!」

617:t_021:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Though he was stopped, $n awakened the $$いがみ合う双子$$ to the Third Stage for just a moment then.」

617:t_021:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$いがみ合う双子$$ $$スフィア$$ is analogous to the principle behind that absolute barrier... They share the same nature.」

617:t_021:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Fire doesn't go out in fire. Water doesn't dissolve in water. That's how it works.」

617:t_021:20.en:
$$トライア$$
「That absolute you believe in had been damaged, however slightly!」

617:t_022:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「You think such meager event control can alter the flow of $$オリジン・ロー$$ in the Imperial Palace?!」

617:t_022:2.en:
$$トライア$$
「That was to send our voices, our wills, and our feelings to the people inside the $$霊子吸収システム$$.」

617:t_023:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$ユニコーン$$! Carry my... our feelings...!」

617:t_024:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「We'll use $$ＹＦ－２９$$'s $$フォールドウェーブシステム$$, too!」

617:t_025:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「All right, you guys! Now you're getting into it!」

617:t_026:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
($$ナナリー$$! If you can hear me, lend me your strength!)

617:t_026:2.en:
$$キラ$$
(Lend us your feelings and your strength!)

617:t_026:3.en:
$$刹那$$
($$マリナ・イスマイール$$! Lend us your wish for peace!)
